description: Thermal-gate background vs arrival time: general capture spectrum + singles(SiPM∧plastic) 2-arm trigger rate per plastic threshold. Shape from high-stats captures, normalisation from trigger_scan.json leg2.
note: H-capture (2.22 MeV γ) deposits <0.5 MIP in plastic, so for b>=0.5 MIP the surviving background is Al-dome-dominated. The exact b-dependent shape/normalisation at high b is MC-floor limited (few tags) — confirm with the biased/high-stats run.
